content.text: {"decision":"NEED_MORE_INFORMATION","supporting_policy_ids":["E01","E02","E03","E04","E05","E06","E07","E08","E09","E10","E11","E12","E13"],"decisive_condition_ids":["a1","a2","a5","a6","a7","a8","a9"],"unresolved_condition_ids":["a3","a4"],"missing_facts":["Devon Gray's Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax paid for the 2025–26 tax year (covering 1 March 2026), to confirm the donor has paid at least as much tax as the Gift Aid amount to be claimed (25p per £1 = £23.75 on a £95 donation)","A valid, complete Gift Aid declaration from Devon Gray that covers this donation — specifically, the missing pages of the scanned form that set out the declaration's scope, duration, and whether it covers this gift, or a separate declaration confirmed to be on file"],"justification":"Seven of the nine conditions for Gift Aid on this £95 donation are satisfied: the charity holds HMRC recognition (a1); Devon Gray donated as an individual from a personal account (a2); the payment was not made through Payroll Giving (a5); it is not a payment for goods or services (a6); no benefit was given to Devon (a7); it is not a donation of shares (a8); and it was not made via charity card or vouchers (a9). However, two conditions remain unresolved. First, a3: the only tax document available is a P60 for the year ending 5 April 2024 (2023–24), which does not establish Devon's tax position for 2025–26, the year in which the 1 March 2026 donation falls. Second, a4: only a partial scan of a Gift Aid declaration form exists, and the pages confirming its coverage and duration are missing; it cannot be confirmed that a valid declaration covering this donation is on record. Both conditions are mandatory under E04/E07 and E05 respectively. Until Devon's 2025–26 tax liability and a complete, applicable Gift Aid declaration are confirmed, the claim cannot proceed.","scope_issues":["This assessment covers only the single £95 payment dated 1 March 2026 from Devon Gray. The charity's recurring monthly direct-debit donations and other one-off donations each constitute separate decision units and would require their own assessments, particularly regarding conditions a3 and a4."],"ir_discrepancies":[{"type":"OTHER","description":"The intermediate representation's limitation note on a4 refers to 'a4 precisely' when discussing the benefit limit (E11), but the benefit limit is actually relevant to a7, not a4. This appears to be a labelling error in the limitations list. It does not affect the condition statuses, which correctly assign the benefit issue to a7.","policy_ids":["E11"],"condition_ids":["a4","a7"]}],"conditional_branches":[{"possible_answer":"YES","conditions_in_words":"Gift Aid can be claimed on the £95 donation if: (1) Devon Gray's Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax paid for the 2025–26 tax year is confirmed to be at least £23.75 (the Gift Aid reclaimable amount of 25p per £1 on £95); AND (2) a valid Gift Aid declaration from Devon Gray that covers this donation is confirmed to be on record (either by locating the missing pages of the existing form or obtaining a new declaration)."},{"possible_answer":"NO","conditions_in_words":"Gift Aid cannot be claimed if Devon Gray's 2025–26 tax paid is less than £23.75, or if no valid Gift Aid declaration covering this donation can be established."}]}
